name: VisualCore unified-app migration ledger (ADR-0009)
rules: The legacy ledger .autonomy/state.json is never reset or rewritten by the migration; its passed gates stay passed.
A gate is recorded only from sealed evidence of real commands (run-check, seal, record).
No device gate may be attempted before ImplementationLock-100 is pass.
Observations made in other repositories or on other builds never satisfy a gate here.

legacy_dispositions.disposition: historical: framework foundation, verified; no new gate. The ProjectM reference regression is rerun by every feature that changes VisualCore.
kept in the legacy ledger and operated with desktop_runbook.py in the original order; each X-A<nn> gate requires its seven legacy gates to be pass.
superseded by the DEV1-, DEV2- and DEV3- rows of the unified app (100 experiences per device); never recorded.
superseded by DEVICE-RECONCILE-100 and RELEASE-PREP; never recorded.

gates.title: Planning corpus consolidated: archive, catalog, Auto-Creator.md, validators

attempts.note: Consolidation of 2026-11-11: archive, catalog, Auto-Creator.md, ledgers, validators. Documentation and tooling only; no app or framework source changed.
Re-verified on main after the owner's ruling of 2026-11-11 (push to main and work from main); Git rules and the pre-push scan changed, nothing else.
